---
title: "4_Differential_Expression"
author: "Noor-Ul-Haya Ahmed"
date: "2026"
output: pdf_document
description: >
  Differential expression analysis for all microarray and RNA-seq
  datasets. Microarray: limma with empirical Bayes moderation.
  RNA-seq: DESeq2 with negative binomial model.
  Key corrections: GSE3307 uses corrected metadata (BMD removed),
  GSE128177 uses age-matched OA (old adult) controls only.
  Results saved to DE_Results/ in standardised format.
  Significance threshold: padj < 0.05, no log2FC filter applied.
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "...") # make own directory
```

```{r libraries}
# ============================================================
# LIBRARIES
# ============================================================
library(limma)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)

dir.create("DE_Results", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load_metadata}
# ============================================================
# LOAD METADATA
# Master metadata for microarray datasets
# Corrected GSE3307 metadata (BMD samples removed)
# Age-stratified GSE128177 metadata (OA controls only)
# ============================================================

meta <- read.csv(
  "metadata/Master_Sample_Metadata2.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
meta$Group     <- trimws(meta$Group)
meta$Dataset   <- trimws(meta$Dataset)
meta$Sample_ID <- trimws(meta$Sample_ID)

# corrected GSE3307 metadata
# 5 Becker MD samples removed from control group
# leaves n=13 true NHM controls
meta_3307_corrected <- read.csv(
  "metadata/GSE3307_corrected_metadata.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Master metadata loaded:", nrow(meta), "samples\n")
cat("GSE3307 corrected metadata:",
    nrow(meta_3307_corrected), "samples\n")
cat("GSE3307 ALS:", sum(meta_3307_corrected$Group == "ALS"), "\n")
cat("GSE3307 Control:", sum(meta_3307_corrected$Group == "Control"), "\n")
```

```{r microarray_de}
# ============================================================
# MICROARRAY DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION — LIMMA
# Datasets: GSE122261, GSE26276, GSE3307, GSE12685,
#           GSE28146, GSE30806
# Method: lmFit() + eBayes() + topTable()
# Significance: padj < 0.05 (Benjamini-Hochberg)
# No log2FC threshold applied
# ============================================================

microarray_datasets <- c(
  "GSE122261", # ALS myotubes (cell line) — secondary
  "GSE26276",  # ALS skeletal muscle — directional only (n=3 vs 2)
  "GSE3307",   # ALS skeletal muscle — PRIMARY (corrected metadata)
  "GSE12685",  # AD brain — non-muscle comparator
  "GSE28146",  # AD brain — non-muscle comparator
  "GSE30806"   # VCP/IBMPFD myopathy skeletal muscle
)

for(gse_id in microarray_datasets){
  cat("\n=================================\n",
      "DE Analysis:", gse_id,
      "\n=================================\n")

  try({

    # load normalised matrix
    expr <- read.csv(
      paste0("Normalised_Data/", gse_id, "_normalised.csv"),
      row.names    = 1,
      check.names  = FALSE
    )
    expr <- as.matrix(expr)
    mode(expr) <- "numeric"

    # ------------------------------------------
    # METADATA — GSE3307 uses corrected version
    # all others use master metadata
    # ------------------------------------------
    if(gse_id == "GSE3307"){

      # corrected metadata: BMD samples removed
      # true NHM controls only (n=13)
      dataset_meta <- meta_3307_corrected %>%
        filter(Group %in% c("ALS", "Control"))

      cat("Using corrected GSE3307 metadata (BMD removed)\n")
      cat("ALS:", sum(dataset_meta$Group == "ALS"), "\n")
      cat("Control:", sum(dataset_meta$Group == "Control"), "\n")

      expr <- expr[, colnames(expr) %in% dataset_meta$Sample_ID]
      dataset_meta <- dataset_meta[
        match(colnames(expr), dataset_meta$Sample_ID),
      ]

      stopifnot(identical(colnames(expr), dataset_meta$Sample_ID))

      group <- factor(dataset_meta$Group,
                      levels = c("Control", "ALS"))

    } else {

      dataset_meta <- meta %>%
        filter(Dataset == gse_id,
               Group   != "Exclude") %>%
        filter(Group %in% c("Disease", "Control",
                            "ALS", "PD", "AD", "Dementia"))

      expr <- expr[, colnames(expr) %in% dataset_meta$Sample_ID]
      dataset_meta <- dataset_meta[
        match(colnames(expr), dataset_meta$Sample_ID),
      ]

      stopifnot(identical(colnames(expr), dataset_meta$Sample_ID))

      dataset_meta$Group_binary <- ifelse(
        dataset_meta$Group %in% c("ALS","PD","AD","Dementia","Disease"),
        "Disease", "Control"
      )

      cat("Disease:", sum(dataset_meta$Group_binary == "Disease"), "\n")
      cat("Control:", sum(dataset_meta$Group_binary == "Control"), "\n")

      group <- factor(dataset_meta$Group_binary,
                      levels = c("Control", "Disease"))
    }

    # ------------------------------------------
    # LIMMA DE
    # ------------------------------------------
    design <- model.matrix(~ group)
    fit    <- lmFit(expr, design)
    fit    <- eBayes(fit)

    res       <- topTable(fit, coef = 2,
                          number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
    res$gene  <- rownames(res)

    res$disease <- case_when(
      gse_id %in% c("GSE122261", "GSE26276", "GSE3307") ~ "ALS",
      gse_id %in% c("GSE12685",  "GSE28146")            ~ "AD",
      gse_id == "GSE30806"                               ~ "VCP_myopathy",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
    res$dataset <- gse_id

    res_standard <- res %>%
      dplyr::select(
        gene,
        log2FC  = logFC,
        pvalue  = P.Value,
        padj    = adj.P.Val,
        dataset,
        disease
      )

    sig <- sum(res_standard$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat("Significant genes (padj < 0.05):", sig, "\n")

    write.csv(
      res_standard,
      paste0("DE_Results/", gse_id, "_DE_results.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    cat("Saved:", gse_id, "\n")

  })
}
```

```{r fix_gse128177_metadata}
# ============================================================
# FIX GSE128177 AGE-STRATIFIED METADATA
# Rebuild from GEO series matrix to get age labels
# OA = older adult controls (retained)
# YA = young adult controls (excluded — age confound)
# ============================================================

gse_128177 <- getGEO(
  filename = "raw_data/GSE128177_series_matrix.txt",
  getGPL   = FALSE
)
pdata_128177 <- pData(gse_128177)

meta_128177_oa <- data.frame(
  Sample_ID = pdata_128177$geo_accession,
  MM_ID     = pdata_128177$title,
  Group_raw = pdata_128177[["group:ch1"]],
  Age       = pdata_128177[["age:ch1"]],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      Group_raw == "Parkinson_disease" ~ "PD",
      Group_raw == "Old_adult"         ~ "Control_Old",
      Group_raw == "Young_adult"       ~ "Control_Young",
      TRUE ~ Group_raw
    )
  )

cat("GSE128177 group breakdown:\n")
table(meta_128177_oa$Group)

write.csv(meta_128177_oa,
          "metadata/GSE128177_OA_metadata.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved GSE128177 age-stratified metadata\n")
```

```{r rnaseq_de}
# ============================================================
# RNA-SEQ DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION — DESEQ2
# Datasets: GSE100188 (ALS small RNA), GSE140089 (PD),
#           GSE128177 (PD, OA controls only)
# Method: DESeq2 negative binomial model
# GSE128177: paired OA controls only — age confound corrected
# GSE100188: analysed separately, not combined with mRNA
# ============================================================

library(GEOquery)

rnaseq_meta <- read.csv(
  "metadata/RNAseq_Sample_Metadata.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
rnaseq_meta$Group     <- trimws(rnaseq_meta$Group)
rnaseq_meta$Sample_ID <- trimws(rnaseq_meta$Sample_ID)
rnaseq_meta$Dataset   <- trimws(rnaseq_meta$Dataset)

meta_128177_oa <- read.csv(
  "metadata/GSE128177_OA_metadata.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rnaseq_datasets <- c("GSE100188", "GSE140089", "GSE128177")

for(gse_id in rnaseq_datasets){
  cat("\n=================================\n",
      "DE Analysis:", gse_id,
      "\n=================================\n")

  try({

    dds <- readRDS(paste0("QC/RNAseq/", gse_id, "_dds.rds"))
    cat("Groups in dds:", levels(factor(dds$Group)), "\n")

    # ------------------------------------------
    # GSE128177: rebuild with OA controls only
    # ------------------------------------------
    if(gse_id == "GSE128177"){

      counts_128177 <- counts(dds)

      meta_128177_fixed <- meta_128177_oa %>%
        filter(Group %in% c("PD", "Control_Old")) %>%
        mutate(Group = ifelse(Group == "Control_Old",
                              "Control", "PD"))

      counts_128177 <- counts_128177[,
        colnames(counts_128177) %in% meta_128177_fixed$Sample_ID]

      meta_128177_fixed <- meta_128177_fixed[
        match(colnames(counts_128177),
              meta_128177_fixed$Sample_ID),
      ]

      stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_128177),
                          meta_128177_fixed$Sample_ID))

      cat("Using OA controls only (age-confound corrected)\n")
      cat("PD:", sum(meta_128177_fixed$Group == "PD"), "\n")
      cat("Control:", sum(meta_128177_fixed$Group == "Control"), "\n")

      dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
        countData = counts_128177,
        colData   = meta_128177_fixed,
        design    = ~ Group
      )
      dds$Group <- factor(dds$Group, levels = c("Control", "PD"))

    } else {

      dds$Group <- factor(
        dds$Group,
        levels = c("Control",
                   ifelse(gse_id == "GSE100188", "ALS", "PD"))
      )
      dds$Group <- droplevels(dds$Group)
    }

    design(dds) <- ~ Group
    dds         <- DESeq(dds)

    disease_label <- ifelse(gse_id == "GSE100188", "ALS", "PD")

    res <- results(
      dds,
      contrast = c("Group", disease_label, "Control"),
      alpha    = 0.05
    )

    res_df         <- as.data.frame(res)
    res_df$gene    <- rownames(res_df)
    res_df$dataset <- gse_id
    res_df$disease <- disease_label

    res_standard <- res_df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        gene,
        log2FC  = log2FoldChange,
        pvalue,
        padj,
        dataset,
        disease
      )

    sig <- sum(res_standard$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat("Significant genes (padj < 0.05):", sig, "\n")

    write.csv(
      res_standard,
      paste0("DE_Results/", gse_id, "_DE_results.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    cat("Saved:", gse_id, "\n")

  })
}
```

```{r standardise_filenames}
# ============================================================
# STANDARDISE FILE NAMES
# Ensure all DE results use lowercase _DE_results.csv
# ============================================================

old_names <- list.files("DE_Results",
                         pattern     = "_DE_Results.csv",
                         full.names  = TRUE)

if(length(old_names) > 0){
  new_names <- gsub("_DE_Results.csv", "_DE_results.csv", old_names)
  file.rename(old_names, new_names)
  cat("Renamed", length(old_names), "files\n")
} else {
  cat("All files already consistently named\n")
}

cat("\nDE results files:\n")
list.files("DE_Results")
```
